name: Ling
source: The last sinner, imprisoned for 216 years. Having never known any other life, Zero bears no resentment toward her confinement and accepts it simply as the way the world is. Even so, she remains endlessly curious, and the smallest things can capture her attention. The thirty days ahead are her first chance to see the world at its most beautiful.
